title: Universidad Tecnológica del Centro de Veracruz - ECBD Repositorio de Prácticas
summary: A student coursework repository of ten Jupyter notebooks for a Knowledge Extraction from Databases (ECBD) class, covering pandas exploration, data cleaning, DIKW/GIGO concepts, and an ETL pipeline to PostgreSQL. Lab10.ipynb imports sdv and sdmetrics and instantiates a SingleTableMetadata object with a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to generate and evaluate synthetic tabular data as a course exercise.
affiliations: Universidad Tecnológica del Centro de Veracruz
